## The purpose of this script is to examine estrogen and andorgen expressing cells


First, we load packages. We might want more later, but for now I know I need the following

```{r load packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(Seurat)
library(readxl)
library(Signac)
library(glue)
library(cowplot)
library(edgeR)
library(limma)
library(patchwork)
```


## Load data

```{r load seurat object and metabolomics excel spreadsheet}
# load 10x multiome data
SSD_data_v5 <- readRDS("../../data/SSD_data_v5.rds")
# remove doublets
SSD_data_v5 <- subset(SSD_data_v5, subset = Droplet == "SNG")

# load hormone metabolomics data
targeted_comparision_raw <- read_xlsx("../../doc/targeted/Targeted Comparison.xlsx")

```

## Examine esrogen and androgen recpetor expression per cell type

```{r make violin plots}

VlnPlot(SSD_data_v5, "AR", assay = "SCT")

VlnPlot(SSD_data_v5, "ESR1", assay = "SCT")

VlnPlot(SSD_data_v5, "ESR2", assay = "SCT")

DefaultAssay(SSD_data_v5) <- "SCT"

FeaturePlot(SSD_data_v5, "ESR2")

DimPlot(SSD_data_v5)

table(SSD_data_v5$cluster_call)

```


```{r get esr2 cells as metadata}

# Identify ESR2-expressing cells
esr2_cells <- WhichCells(SSD_data_v5, expression = ESR2 != 0)

# Add metadata column for labeling
SSD_data_v5 <- AddMetaData(object = SSD_data_v5, metadata = ifelse(colnames(SSD_data_v5) %in% esr2_cells, "ESR2_positive", "ESR2_negative"), col.name = "ESR2_expression_status")

# Figure out which cell type have the most ESR2
SSD_data_v5$ESR2_positive_SCT <- SSD_data_v5@assays$SCT@data["ESR2",] > 0

percentage_ESR2_by_cell_type_SCT <- SSD_data_v5@meta.data %>%
    group_by(cluster_call) %>%
    summarize(percent_ESR2_positive = mean(ESR2_positive_SCT) * 100)

# Visualize the data
ggplot(percentage_ESR2_by_cell_type_SCT, aes(x = cluster_call, y = percent_ESR2_positive, fill = percent_ESR2_positive)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = "Percentage of ESR2-expressing Cells (any) by Cell Type",
         x = "Cell Type",
         y = "Percentage of ESR2-expressing Cells")

# try for "high"
SSD_data_v5$ESR2_positive_SCT_high <- SSD_data_v5@assays$SCT@data["ESR2",] > 1

percentage_ESR2_by_cell_type_SCT_high <- SSD_data_v5@meta.data %>%
    group_by(cluster_call) %>%
    summarize(percent_ESR2_positive = mean(ESR2_positive_SCT_high) * 100)

# Visualize the data
ggplot(percentage_ESR2_by_cell_type_SCT_high, aes(x = cluster_call, y = percent_ESR2_positive, fill = percent_ESR2_positive)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = "Percentage of ESR2-expressing Cells (high) by Cell Type",
         x = "Cell Type",
         y = "Percentage of ESR2-expressing Cells")

# try for "med"
SSD_data_v5$ESR2_positive_SCT_med <- SSD_data_v5@assays$SCT@data["ESR2",] > 0.5

percentage_ESR2_by_cell_type_SCT_med <- SSD_data_v5@meta.data %>%
    group_by(cluster_call) %>%
    summarize(percent_ESR2_positive = mean(ESR2_positive_SCT_med) * 100)

# Visualize the data
ggplot(percentage_ESR2_by_cell_type_SCT_med, aes(x = cluster_call, y = percent_ESR2_positive, fill = percent_ESR2_positive)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = "Percentage of ESR2-expressing Cells (med) by Cell Type",
         x = "Cell Type",
         y = "Percentage of ESR2-expressing Cells")

```
